edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Seller the Purchase Price for the Shares in immediately available funds, in accordance with the payment instructions designated by the Seller in writing. The Purchase Price and any agreed adjustments shall be set forth in a written schedule in the form agreed and signed by both parties and attached to this Agreement as Schedule 1 before this Agreement is signed. No party shall be obligated to consummate the transactions unless Schedule 1 has been completed, signed by both parties, and attached.
edits.name: Purchase Price

edits.text:
4. INDEMNITY.
(a) Indemnity. Subject to the procedures and limitations in this Section, the Seller shall indemnify and hold harmless the Buyer from and against all losses, liabilities, damages, judgments, settlements, penalties, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys’ fees) arising out of or resulting from any liability of the Company existing at or before Closing that was not disclosed in writing to the Buyer before Closing. This indemnity includes losses arising from a liability that was contingent, unasserted, or unknown at Closing. It does not apply to a matter disclosed in writing to the Buyer before Closing or to the extent a loss is reflected as a specific adjustment in the Purchase Price schedule or is recovered under another provision of this Agreement; there shall be no double recovery.
(b) Claim notice. The Buyer shall give the Seller written notice describing a claim in reasonable detail, including the known basis and estimated amount, within a reasonable time after becoming aware of it. A delay in notice shall relieve the Seller of its obligations only to the extent the Seller is materially prejudiced by that delay. A claim notice delivered before expiration of the applicable survival period preserves the claim until its final resolution.
(c) Third-party claims. For a claim brought by a third party, the Seller may assume the defense with counsel reasonably acceptable to the Buyer by giving written notice within 20 days after receiving the claim notice. The Buyer may participate with its own counsel at its own expense, except that the Seller shall pay the reasonable cost of separate counsel if an actual conflict of interest makes joint representation inappropriate. The Seller may not settle a claim without the Buyer’s prior written consent if the settlement imposes any non-monetary obligation on, or admission of fault by, the Buyer or the Company, or does not provide the Buyer and the Company an unconditional release. If the Seller does not timely assume the defense, the Buyer may defend and settle the claim reasonably, after consulting with the Seller, at the Seller’s expense subject to the limits in subsection (e).
(d) Direct claims. For a claim that is not a third-party claim, the Seller shall have 30 days after receipt of notice to respond. The parties shall then attempt in good faith to resolve the claim; the Buyer may pursue any unresolved claim in accordance with this Agreement.
(e) Survival and limits. A claim under subsection (a) must be noticed no later than 24 months after Closing. The Seller’s aggregate liability under subsection (a) shall not exceed 20% of the Purchase Price, and the Seller shall have no liability under subsection (a) unless aggregate covered losses exceed 1% of the Purchase Price, in which event the Seller is liable only for losses in excess of that threshold. These limits do not apply to fraud or intentional misrepresentation by the Seller. The Buyer shall take commercially reasonable steps to mitigate losses.
edits.name: Indemnity

receiver.message_back: The signed Schedule 1 requirement and the indemnity’s coverage of undisclosed pre-Closing liabilities are acceptable in principle, but the 20% cap, 1% deductible basket, and 24-month survival period leave the Buyer materially underprotected. Please revise to a 100% of Purchase Price cap, a tipping basket, and a three-year survival period (with fraud and intentional misrepresentation remaining uncapped); we can then review the completed Schedule 1.
